name: Zilli
why: Lyon's maximal luxury for the yacht deck.
origin: Lyon, 1965 — leather and cashmere maximal luxury.
opview: ‘The finest garments for men’ — the house's stated ambition.

notes.boat: Maximal luxury for a deck with staff on it. Nothing about the register suggests the wearer handles a line.
notes.fren: A Lyon house that calls itself a French luxury menswear maison — founded 1965 by a French family in partnership with Teofilo Zilli, an Italian tailor working in the city. Raised from 3 on 2026-08-09: the map had it more Italian than French, which its base and its own description contradict.
notes.ital: Genuinely half the story rather than the whole of it. The co-founder was an Italian tailor and two of the three ateliers are Italian — Bergamo and Pescara — but Lyon is the house. Lowered from 5 on 2026-08-09 to sit level with Frenchness, which is what a French-Italian house should look like on two dials. Note the founding date is given variously as 1965 and 1970; the house's own pages say 1965.

cities: No US store on the brand's own locator, which lists 22 countries and not the United States
